description: Source code for utility functions related to player testing in the starboard/nplb namespace, including test file lists, configuration helpers, and sample writing functions.

methods.name: GetAudioTestFiles
methods.description: Returns a vector of audio test file names used in player tests.

methods.name: GetVideoTestFiles
methods.description: Returns a vector of video test file names used in player tests.

methods.name: GetPlayerOutputModes
methods.description: Returns a vector of supported SbPlayerOutputMode values.

methods.name: GetKeySystems
methods.description: Returns a vector of key system strings, including empty string and predefined key systems.

methods.name: GetSupportedSbPlayerTestConfigs
methods.description: Generates a list of test configurations based on supported audio/video files, codecs, output modes, and key system.

methods.name: GetSbPlayerTestConfigName
methods.description: Creates a string name for a test configuration based on its parameters.

methods.name: DummyDeallocateSampleFunc
methods.description: Dummy function for deallocating samples, does nothing.

methods.name: DummyDecoderStatusFunc
methods.description: Dummy function for decoder status callback, does nothing.

methods.name: DummyPlayerStatusFunc
methods.description: Dummy function for player status callback, does nothing.

methods.name: DummyErrorFunc
methods.description: Dummy function for error callback, does nothing.

methods.name: CallSbPlayerCreate
methods.description: Creates an SbPlayer with specified parameters, including DRM and audio/video info.

methods.name: CallSbPlayerWriteSamples
methods.description: Writes samples to the SbPlayer from a VideoDmpReader, handling sample info and optional enhanced audio extension.

methods.name: IsOutputModeSupported
methods.description: Checks if a specific output mode is supported for given codecs and key system.

methods.name: IsPartialAudioSupported
methods.description: Determines if partial audio frames are supported based on API version.

methods.name: IsAudioPassthroughUsed
methods.description: Checks if the audio codec in the config is passthrough (AC3 or EAC3).
